title: Apply for a motor dealer wholesaler licence
summary: Use this page to apply for a motor dealer wholesaler licence, which allows you to buy, sell, or exchange motor vehicles with financiers and other licence holders.
intro:
A motor dealer wholesaler licence allows you to buy, sell or exchange motor vehicles with financiers and other licence holders.

You can buy vehicles from the public but you can't sell direct or through auction, to the general public.

You can apply for a 1-year, 3-year or 5-year licence, online.
who_can_apply: Be at least 18 years of age.
Be considered fit and proper for the licence (NSW Fair Trading checks and considers police records).
Not be disqualified from holding a licence due to disciplinary action.
Not be a controlled member of a declared organisation.
Not have been found guilty of a motor vehicle stealing offence in the past 10 years.
Have sufficient financial resources to run the business according to Fair Trading requirements.
Have approval from the relevant local council.
what_you_need: Personal and contact details of the individual or business partners.
Business details, including the registered name of the business.
The completed PDF form: 'Manager's Consent Form' (if applicable).

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to apply for your licence.
Download and complete Application for a Licence – PDF (including the Manager's Consent Form section, if applicable).
Submit your application with payment at a Service NSW Centre.

more_info.text: A corporation must nominate an individual to be manager of the day-to-day business of the licensee. An individual may manage the business themselves or nominate another individual to manage the business.
Where there is more than one manager, a separate Manager’s Consent Form must be completed for each manager.
Once you're licensed as a motor dealer wholesaler, you must display your licence name and number at your place of business, and publish them on any advertising or promotional material.

faqs.q: What does a motor dealer wholesaler licence allow me to do?
faqs.a: A motor dealer wholesaler licence allows you to buy, sell, or exchange motor vehicles with financiers and other licence holders.

faqs.q: Can I sell vehicles directly to the general public?
faqs.a: You can buy vehicles from the public, but you cannot sell directly or through auction to the general public.

faqs.q: What are the licence duration options?
faqs.a: You can apply for a 1-year, 3-year, or 5-year licence.
